== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Carmine is a human inhabitant of [[Sarcoline City]]. He has experienced significant trauma involving monsters that destroyed his home and killed everyone he knew. During recent events, he has displayed intense emotional instability, fluctuating between fury, despair, and a desire to fight. Physically, he has appeared sickly, characterized by trembling hands and extremely pale skin. Carmine has expressed a sense of inadequacy regarding combat and has shown desperation to stop ongoing tests, even stating he is willing to face any personal consequence if it means the threats are eliminated.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Carmine is a sixteen-year-old boy characterized by his lanky limbs and messy black hair. He wears clothing consisting of various shades of red and black.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sixteen-year-old Carmine is a lanky boy with messy black hair, typically dressed in clothing consisting of red and black shades. After monsters from [[Eternity Incorporated]] destroyed his home, he was discovered shaking amidst broken glass. The group rescued him while he clutched [[Kelthryss]], and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] subsequently provided him with a list of survivors.}}
